description: Starts Sergio writing quiz questions for a module's atoms, as Generate questions does (owner or admin seats only). Atoms that already have questions are skipped unless regenerate: true (which replaces them); sop_ids limits it to some atoms. It runs in the background: read training_modules with module_id for generation_status and the questions. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat never starts a second run.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: generate_training_questions
title: Have Sergio write quiz questions
